findings.evidenceJa: 暗黙の了解になりつつある屋上で合流して
findings.governingReading: they meet on the roof, which is becoming an unspoken mutual understanding
findings.explanation: An emerging tacit routine is turned into compliance with an explicit agreement.

findings.evidenceJa: いつになく怒り出した遠坂だった
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka had become angry in a way unusual for her
findings.explanation: The marked departure from Rin’s usual demeanor disappears into an ungrammatical fragment.

findings.evidenceJa: 気合っていうより敵意に近い迫力
findings.governingReading: an intensity closer to hostility than fighting spirit
findings.explanation: The precise threatening quality driving Shirou backward is reduced to generic attitude.

findings.highlight: As if her attitude wasn’t bad enough
findings.evidenceJa: その迫力だけでも手に余る
findings.governingReading: her sheer intensity is already more than he can handle
findings.explanation: The English adds a negative judgment of Rin’s attitude and removes Shirou’s comic inability to cope with her force.

findings.highlight: There’s nowhere for me to run
findings.evidenceJa: うう人類に逃げ場なし
findings.governingReading: alas, humanity has nowhere left to flee
findings.explanation: The trapped-rat joke’s grandiose escalation from Shirou to all humanity is normalized back to his literal predicament.
